pageProps.content: ## Overview of Ballerina Swan Lake Update 12 (2201.12.12) Swan Lake Update 12 (2201.12.12) is the twelfth patch release of Ballerina 2201.12.0 (Swan Lake Update 12) and it includes a new set of bug fixes. ## Update Ballerina Run the command below to update your current Ballerina installation directly to 2201.12.12 by using the [Ballerina Update Tool](/learn/update-tool/). ``` $ bal dist pull 2201.12.12 ``` ## Install Ballerina If you have not installed Ballerina, then, download the [installers](/downloads/#swanlake) to install. ## Language updates ### Bug fixes To view bug fixes, see the [GitHub milestone for Swan Lake Update 12 (2201.12.12)](https://github.com/ballerina-platform/ballerina-lang/milestone/205?closed=1).
